profile.headline: Front End Web Developer at MI Digital Solution
profile.summary: I am a recent Graphic Design graduate with a Bachelors Degree in Marketing. As a 3-time Disney College Program participant, I have gained many customer service skills as well as experienced professional interactions with people from a wide range of backgrounds.

positions.title: Jr Web Developer
positions.description: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Illustrator · Elementor · WordPress

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
-Responds to customer questions with personal product knowledge.
-Creates strategies to develop and expand customer satisfaction.
-Takes part in discussions with team members to establish sales and customer retention goals.
-Developed and runs store Instagram and Facebook accounts to connect with customer base and community.

positions.title: Graphic Design Intern
positions.description:
-Designs promotional graphics about services for weekly newsletter.
-Collaborates with Group82 clients to design logos and cover art.

positions.title: Disney College Program Intern - Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique Hostess
positions.description:
-Maintained the role of "Fairy Godmother in Training" throughout a guest's experience.
-Utilized a computerized reservation system to check in guests for their appointment.
-Responsible for ensuring guest satisfaction by giving prompt, friendly and knowledgeable service.
-Worked closely with children ages 2-12 including calming upset children and storytelling.
-Monitored stock levels and restocked as necessary.
-Worked in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

positions.title: Disney College Program Intern - Merchandise
positions.description:
-Handled cash and other forms of payment.
-Managed multiple tasks and worked well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
 -Delivered daily guest service in Fortune 100 Company.
-Responsible for ensuring guest satisfaction by giving prompt, friendly and knowledgeable service.
-Performed excellent verbal and written communication skills.
-Helped guests find the merchandise they wanted as well as introducing them to other products they might be interested in.

positions.title: Disney College Program Intern
positions.description:
-Used a computerized system to take guests orders. 
-Performed excellent verbal and written communication skills.
-Maintained a clean and safe work and guest environment.
-Ability to manage multiple tasks and work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
-Prepared made-to-order foods using fryers, ovens, and other kitchen equipment.
